subtasks: Pour the violet bottle into the white bowl. Wait for the liquid to settle, then return the bottle upright to the table and release it.
Pour the liquid from the turquoise bottle into the black bowl on the right. Wait for the liquid to settle, then put the turquoise bottle upright on the table and release it.

Pour the liquid from the red bottle in the middle into the brown bowl on the left. Wait for the liquid to settle, put the red bottle upright on the table, then fully open both grippers and return both arms to their initial poses.
Bring the held red bottle upright and place it gently on the table between the turquoise and violet bottles. Fully open both grippers and return both arms to their initial poses.
Return both empty arms directly to their initial resting poses and keep both grippers fully open.
